description: This file defines structures and a singleton enum for sanitizing and inspecting environment variable overrides related to host environment security policies. It includes functions for filtering, normalizing, and checking environment variable keys against security rules.

classes.name: HostEnvOverrideDiagnostics
classes.description: A struct representing diagnostics information about environment variable overrides, including which keys are blocked or invalid.

methods.name: inspectOverrides
methods.description: Analyzes provided environment variable overrides and returns diagnostics indicating blocked or invalid keys.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes environment variable overrides, filtering out blocked or invalid keys, and merging with current environment variables.
